title: Right-click and keyboard
text: Opens on right-click, Shift+F10, or the context menu key at the right spot.

title: Native menu kept
text: Shift+right-click still shows the browser menu unless you turn that off.

title: Knows the origin
text: Select events report the element that was right-clicked, for per-row actions.

title: Same items as Menu
text: Submenus, checkboxes, radio groups, separators, and groups work alike.
